_comment: Scope per the published policy: web services owned by LithicBlue that
handle sensitive user data, 'e.g. properties hosted on https://*.lithicblue.com'.
NOTE: the policy excludes findings produced by automated scanners or AI
tooling. Use this only to MAP attack surface. Vulnerability discovery must
be original manual research, and marketing pages that handle no sensitive
user data are outside the qualification criteria.
